summary: The9 Limited filed a 6-K with a press release announcing that its investee Nanyang Biologics (NYB) obtained shareholder approval at RF Acquisition Corp II's extraordinary general meeting on August 19, 2026, for the proposed business combination, a SPAC merger. The9 expects to hold approximately 15-16% of the combined Nasdaq-listed company under ticker NYB, via its wholly-owned subsidiary Gamenow. The filing notes the deal is subject to customary closing conditions; CEO George Lai expressed confidence. NYB is an AI-driven drug discovery firm. The filing is informational, with no advisor or deal terms disclosed.
